set.st: James Becker is said to have hidden $50,000 in government bonds in the woods near Glidden before he died in 1893. Only 15 cents was ever recovered. LiDAR cache check (USGS 1 m, 2019): Nothing that fits the story stands out within the search area: the pits and lines it finds there are ditches, banks, ponds or natural ground. A period paper (Beloit Weekly News, 15 Dec 1893) puts the hut about 25 miles from Glidden and says searchers found nothing; the only direct account of the search (15 cents found) comes through Lesy's 1973 book. Direction from Glidden is not given, so the pin stays approximate.
set.pl: Woods near Glidden (about 25 miles out, direction not given)
